control_result.scope: Exact AST LineProfiler with synthetic event sequence and fixed memory sample, no sys.settrace or real RSS sampling

findings: LineProfiler.prevline is shared across tracked code objects. Nested callback events misattribute inner return line 22 to outer code, omitting outer line 11. Reproduced with exact class and synthetic frames.

trace_memory_usage stores maximum RSS for each previous line, while show_results subtracts adjacent displayed maxima. Increment is not a sum of allocations or a matched per-invocation delta; no peak allocation claim justified.

LineProfiler wrapper restores its tracing function in finally and counts nested enables; previous trace callback is invoked but its returned local callback is discarded, so full debugger/coverage composition remains unqualified.

magic_mprun restores an existing builtins.profile but does not remove newly inserted profile when none existed. CLI injects builtins.profile without restoring it. Static finding; no global builtins mutation executed.
magic_memit uses repeat == 1 rather than assignment when repeat is below one; repeat zero executes no target iteration. Static finding, IPython magic not run.
CLI finally prints results but output file opened in append mode is not explicitly closed; script/read/results errors may mask target failures. Static only.
TimeStamper records end sample in finally, but failures during end sampling can supersede target exceptions. Trace/GC/system sampling affect observations and need independent paired benchmarks.
